articles.title: An Ohio appeals court on Oct 26 upheld a zoning ban on Airbnb rentals in a 140-home neighbourhood
articles.description: An Ohio appellate court has confirmed a zoning restriction prohibiting short-term rentals in a suburban area. Michael A. Clevenger, an owner looking to operate an Airbnb, faced opposition from neighbors concerned about excessive noise, parking congestion, and heightened safety risks from frequent guests. This ruling emphasizes the importance of adhering to local zoning regulations that maintain the integrity of residential neighborhoods, reinforcing existing legal frameworks against short-term rental operations.

articles.title: A $295 million Malibu mansion by Pritzker Prize-winning architect Tadao Ando was quietly on the market when Kanye West came unannounced
articles.description: Kanye West made an unplanned visit to a stunning Malibu mansion crafted by Tadao Ando, spending four days there. He secured a stay without prior arrangement, likening his presence to that of Elvis Presley. Meanwhile, the estate was later sold to Jay-Z and Beyoncé, breaking sales records. West's personal Ando-designed property, however, is grappling with legal and financial troubles, leaving its future uncertain due to ongoing foreclosure issues.

articles.title: Maine Forest Protections Secure Jobs: Coalition preserves 27,000 acres; working forest still supports timber, recreation
articles.description: In a remarkable achievement, over 27,000 acres of forestland in western Maine have been safeguarded through collaborative conservation efforts. This extensive initiative spanned six years, bringing together environmental groups, state agencies, and local trusts. Preserving this land is vital for ensuring clean drinking water for more than 200,000 residents while supporting timber jobs and enhancing recreational opportunities and habitats for wildlife in the area.

articles.title: Once a textile giant, now homes and offices: Virginia’s abandoned mill gets a $110 million makeover
articles.description: Dan River Falls embodies a transformative redevelopment of the historic White Mill, originally constructed in 1920, located in Danville. Completed in November 2024, the first phase features 190 residential apartments. Plans for the future include developing a vibrant riverfront park and retail area. This public-private collaboration strives to maintain the mill's historic integrity while breathing new life into the community and catering to workforce housing needs.

As AI tools challenge Alphabet's search advertising dominance, investors remain anxious, especially with reports of unfavorable free cash flow suggesting potential challenges for future profits.

articles.title: Patrick Stewart dies at 86 after battle with Alzheimer’s and Lewy body dementia
articles.description: Sir Patrick Stewart, the celebrated British actor known for Star Trek: The Next Generation and the X-Men franchise, has died at 86 at his Los Angeles home, according to a family statement. His death follows a battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia. The acclaimed actor leaves behind a six-decade legacy across theatre, television and cinema.

articles.description: Halle Berry and Oliver Martinez are embroiled in a heated custody battle concerning their son, Maceo.
